brief: Prioritise the asset for pre-event attention because units of advanced age with a history of high loading have a reduced margin against mechanical failure (MG-023). Review open work orders to re-prioritise outstanding items against the unit's ability to shed heat, focusing on categories 1 through 3 before the event begins (SOP-016). Where an ageing unit cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure (MG-023).
